title: Mixed Event — An Unmissable Spirited Affair — Episode4 A Road Less Lonely

meta.Event Outline: Kamiyama High School's second-years are headed to Kyoto! In contrast with Tsukasa's excitement for their school trip, Rui is less enthused. But will his feelings change when one of his classmates approaches him?

rows.Line: Kyoto

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's head to the shrine for the performing arts!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, before we do, mind if we take a quick detour?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where, Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Between here and the shrine, there's supposed to be a big street with lots of shops... We should be able to buy souvenirs and have a quick tea break.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, would that be okay?
It'll also give you two a chance to find some souvenirs like you said.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great!
Then, we'll start with the street of souvenir shops!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow...!
So many shops...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's see... Based on this map, there's a souvenir shop on the street just ahead, with a little tea shop further along.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that bulletin says a new Japanese sweet shop apparently just opened up in the area where the tea shop is. It seems very popular.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Japanese sweets?!
That's definitely going on the list...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, we gotta check it out later and–

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
These candies look like gemstones!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, these could work very well as a stage prop if we made a ring using some. I can see it already... The king eats his own ring as he goes mad with power...

rows.Speaker: Airi & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you can try this mochi?
Then, I'd like a sample!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, don't wander off without us!
Have you forgotten that your phone's out of battery?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, a textile shop.
It'd be nice to make some costumes out of these fabrics someday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, that goes for you too!
Don't wander off like that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is turning into quite a lively day...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's find some souvenirs for our nearest and dearest!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Mutsuhashi are pretty standard...
But I kinda want to get something more fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, how about these?
Grapefruit-flavored mutsuhashi gummies!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grapefruit-flavored mutsuhashi gummies?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's quite the combination...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess this kind of tragedy is what happens when the tourism industry goes a little too far...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But they could be worth getting.
Emu likes these sorts of strange snacks, and Nene likes grapefruit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That doesn't justify buying these!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena might like some of these blotting sheets...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're getting those for her, Asahina?
Then, I think I'll get this powder puff...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It would've been nice to also run into Ena here since we're all second years.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's sorta doubtful since night school students don't have their trip at the same time as regular students.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we should take this opportunity to get her some nice gifts!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not seeing one anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What are you looking for, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, one of those golden Kyoto figurines...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Golden Kyoto figurines...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you mean one of those porcelain dolls made in Kyoto, but colored gold...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, what are you talking about?!
There's no way they make those!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's unfortunate... I've searched for them everywhere to no avail... I was hoping to get one for Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're looking for something for Saki?
In that case...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How about some of these colorful comfits? They look like little stars.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
And they're very cute! Excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
I think I'll get some for Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How adorable is it going to be when they have these together with their friends?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...!
A harmonious scene indeed!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Thank goodness... Saki's going to get a real gift...
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it for souvenirs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I see a Japanese sweet shop up ahead. Shall we take a break there?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Hehe. I can't wait to see what they have♪ Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-Where'd Shizuku go?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What?!
This is terrible...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It is...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, because she's—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Oh, this is so lovely...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
There she is!

rows.Speaker: Old Store Clerk
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll look very good on you, miss.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
But this looks so well made... I'm not sure I can afford it...

rows.Speaker: Old Store Clerk
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're in for a nice surprise.
I make these as a part of my hobby.
How does this much sound?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, my allowance can cover that...!
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Old Store Clerk
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
Again, your phone has no power, so losing sight of you immediately turns into a big emergency!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's prone to getting lost?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
Her sense of direction leaves something to be desired...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I found something wonderful that really caught my attention...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Something wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, what a lovely haori.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These snowflakes... They've been embroidered so carefully onto this white fabric...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's also what I liked about it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really pretty... But when are you gonna wear it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was thinking of using it as a bed jacket since I'm not sure when I'd wear this outside.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
R-Really?! A bed jacket?!
This looks way too nice for that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: W-Would that be bad?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, but...
I guess that does suit you best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all back together, let's head over to that sweet shop!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right!
And after that, we can head over to the shrine for the performing arts!
Shrine for the Performing Arts

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here!
And still all together...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, shall we go make our wishes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay!
Ready, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will!!! Become!!! The world's greatest star!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Who shouts like that while making their wish?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Th-That was alarming...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree... I'm used to this in your case, but I doubt many people shout out their wishes the way you did...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
W-Wait, but...!
I need to be loud if I want this shrine's deity to hear me, no?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-They probably felt your presence...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe... Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
It's just... Tsukasa really hasn't changed since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Actually, Hinomori...
How long have you two known each other?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't ask you that. It seems like you two have known each other forever...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've known Tsukasa since we were in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, you're childhood friends?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Actually...
We didn't play that often together, but I suppose we're something like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that seems fair.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I first met him when we were in second grade...
